title: Audio Deepfake Attribution: An Initial Dataset and Investigation
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical aspects of detecting and attributing deepfake audio, including dataset creation, model development, and experimental evaluation. While it mentions the societal hazards and malicious uses of deepfake audio, it does not evaluate or benchmark models on ethical reasoning, moral judgments, or religious/spiritual topics. The ethical component is about the problem being solved (deepfake misuse) rather than an evaluation of faith or ethics within the model itself.
